title: Bifid

inlines.v: BIF'ID BIF'IDATE, adjective [Latin bifidus, bifidatus, of bis, twice, and findo, fidi, to split or cleave. See Divide and Wide.] In botany, two-cleft; divided; opening with a cleft; divided by a linear sinus, with straight margins.
